source:
@@U03152@@
(Snarling.)

@@U03153@@
I don’t like him!

@@U03155@@
(Snarling even worse.)

@@U03156@@
What does he want of us?

@@U03158@@
Nasty man! He doesn’t belong here!

@@U03160@@
(Brutally)

@@U03161@@
Perhaps you think your visitor is short on nails to tear with, compared with your sharp claws? Try me! We'll see!

@@U03163@@
(Gently)

@@U03164@@
You may stay. You'll soon be wanting to leave by your own choice. Where you come from, you think you're somebody, but here, if I’m not mistaken, you're ill at ease.

@@U03166@@
Your upper half is really quite appetizing; it’s the down-below I find disgusting.

@@U03168@@
False creature, you'll pay for your rudeness! Our claws are healthy, but you with your shriveled horse’s hoof will find no pleasure in our company.

@@U03169@@
(塞壬们 are heard tuning up in the poplar trees.)

@@U03171@@
What are those birds in the poplar trees by the river?

@@U03173@@
Be on your guard! Their sing-song has destroyed the very best of men.
translation:
@@U03152@@
（咆哮。）

@@U03153@@
我不喜欢他！

@@U03155@@
（咆哮得更厉害。）

@@U03156@@
他想从我们这里得到什么？

@@U03158@@
可恶的男人！他不属于这里！

@@U03160@@
（残酷地）

@@U03161@@
也许您认为与您锋利的爪子相比，您的访客没有足够的指甲来撕扯？试试我吧！我们拭目以待吧！

@@U03163@@
（轻轻地）

@@U03164@@
你可以留下来。你很快就会想根据自己的选择离开。在你来自的地方，你认为自己很重要，但在这里，如果我没记错的话，你会感到不安。

@@U03166@@
你的上半身真是太有食欲了；我觉得恶心的是下面的地方。

@@U03168@@
虚伪的生物，你将为你的无礼付出代价！我们的爪子很健康，但你的马蹄枯萎了，在我们的陪伴下不会有任何乐趣。

@@U03169@@
（可以听到塞壬人在白杨树上调音。）

@@U03171@@
河边杨树上的那些鸟是什么？

@@U03173@@
保持警惕！他们的歌声毁掉了最优秀的人。
